articles.description: Amathiphu nezhuzhuzo ngamawebhusayithi, ukuzenzakalela kwemisebenzi, nokukhulisa ibhizinisi lakho nge-inthanethi.
hero.board.title: Ibhodi lokwethula
services.description: Sihlanganisa amasu okuqukethwe, ukuklama kwesixhumi nabasebenzisi, nokwenziwa kwezobuchwepheshe ukuze iwebhusayithi yakho ingabi sebhengezweni nje kuphela, kodwa isebenze ngempela.
services.0.title: Iphothifoliyo / i-CV yomuntu siqu
services.0.description: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo noma i-CV yomuntu siqu ukwethula iphrofayili yakho, ulwazi nomsebenzi wakho ngobungcweti.
services.1.title: Ikhasi lokufika noma iphrofayili yenkampani
services.1.description: Ikhasi lokufika noma iphrofayili yenkampani ethuleka ngokushesha, ebukeka iqinisekisa futhi isilungele ukudonsa amakhasimende.
services.2.title: Uhlelo lolwazi nolokusebenza
services.2.description: Amadashibhodi, amaphothali nezinhlelo zangaphakathi zokulawula idatha yakho nemisebenzi yansuku zonke yebhizinisi.
services.3.title: Ukuzenzakalela
services.3.description: Zenzakalele izinqubo eziphindaphindwayo njengezaziso, ukuxhumanisa amathuluzi nokugeleza komsebenzi ukuze ithimba lakho longe isikhathi.
process.description: Isinyathelo ngasinye sinemiphumela ongayibona, ayivivinye futhi uyigunyaze. Uyazi ngempela ukuthi umsebenzi uyaphi.
process.0.title: Ukuhlola izidingo
process.0.description: Sihlela imigomo yebhizinisi, izinkomba zokubukeka, izici eziyinhloko nezinto okufanele zenziwe kuqala.
process.1.title: Ukubuyekeza idizayini
process.1.description: Isakhiwo, idizayini nokugeleza kubuyekezwa futhi kugunyazwe ndawonye ngaphambi kokukhiqizwa.
process.2.title: Ukwakha
process.2.description: Iwebhusayithi, i-app noma ukuzenzakalela kwakhiwa ngendlela eguquguqukayo ngokuya ngedizayini eyagunyazwa.
process.3.title: Ukubuyekeza umphumela
process.3.description: Umphumela ubuyekezwa ndawonye, ulungiswe uma kunesidingo, bese uvivinywa kuze kube usulungele ukwethulwa.
process.4.title: Ukwethula nokudlulisela
process.4.description: Umkhiqizo uyashicilelwa, i-metadata ne-SEO kuyasethwa, bese sikudlulisela ukufinyelela nesiqondiso.
services.0.long: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo noma ye-CV yomuntu siqu iyikhaya lakho elisemthethweni ku-inthanethi. Iphrofayili yakho, ulwazi nomsebenzi kuhlanganiswe kahle ekhasini elilodwa elilula ukuliyabelana nabaqashi, amakhasimende noma amanyuvesi.
services.0.for: Abaqede kushesha ukufunda, abasebenzi ngokuzimela, abadali nochwepheshe abafuna ukubukeka beqinisekisa.
services.1.long: Ikhasi lokufika noma iphrofayili yenkampani isiza ibhizinisi ukuthi lenze umbono omuhle wokuqala. Sakha ukugeleza kwekhasi, amagama nokubukeka ukuze izivakashi zizwe ngokushesha lokho okunikelayo futhi zikhuthazeke ukuxhumana nawe.
services.1.detail.3: Ukusetha i-SEO ukuze ufinyeleleke kalula ku-Google
services.1.detail.4: Kuthuleka ngokushesha uma izinto zakho sezilungile
services.1.for: Amabhizinisi, izikole, ama-kafe, imiphakathi nezinkampani ezifuna ukubukeka ngobungcweti.
services.2.long: Uhlelo lolwazi lulungisa umsebenzi okwamanje osabalele phakathi kwamashidi, amanothi nezingxoxo. Idatha ihlala endaweni eyodwa, ifinyelelwa ngokwendima, futhi imibiko ingabukwa noma nini.
services.2.detail.0: Ukugeleza komsebenzi okuhlelekile okulandela indlela osebenza ngayo
services.2.for: Izikole, izikhungo, izitolo, amapulazi nezinkampani ezifuna ukuphatha idatha ngendlela ehlelekile kakhulu.
services.3.long: Imisebenzi ephindaphindwayo efana nokuthumela izaziso, ukudlulisa idatha phakathi kwama-app noma ukwenza imibiko evamile ingasebenza yodwa. Ithimba lakho longa isikhathi futhi lugwema amaphutha okuthayipha.
services.3.for: Amabhizinisi namathimba anomsebenzi omningi ophindaphindwayo owenziwa ngesandla.
process.0.long: Ngaphambi kokwakha noma yini, sifuna ukuliqonda ibhizinisi lakho: iyini inhloso, ayobani izivakashi, nokuthi yiziphi izici ezibalulekile kakhulu. Kusuka lapho sibeka okubalulekile kuqala ukuze umsebenzi uhlale ugxilile futhi kugwenywe izindleko ezingadingekile.
process.0.you: Sitshele ngezidingo zakho futhi wabelane ngezibonelo zamawebhusayithi owathandayo.
process.0.result: Uhlu lwezidingo nezinto eziza kuqala okuvunyelwene ngazo ndawonye.
process.1.long: Siqala ngokuhlela isakhiwo samakhasi nesithombe sokubukeka. Ungakubuyekeza futhi unikeze impendulo ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukwakhiwa, ukuze umphumela wokugcina uhlale useduze nalokho owakucabanga.
process.1.do.1: Ukuklama ukubukeka: imibala, ukuhleleka kanye nesitayela
process.1.you: Buyekeza idizayini, bese unikeza impendulo noma imvume.
process.1.result: Idizayini evunyelwene ngayo ndawonye ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukukhiqizwa.
process.2.long: Uma idizayini isigunyaziwe, iwebhusayithi, i-app noma ukuzenzakalela kuyakhiwa. Kuguquguquka kumafoni nasemakhompyutheni, futhi ungabelana ngempendulo kuyilapho umsebenzi uqhubeka.
process.2.do.1: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kubukeka kahle kumafoni, kumathebulethi nasemakhompyutheni
process.2.do.2: Ukulungiselela okuyisisekelo ukuze kufinyeleleke kalula ku-Google
process.2.you: Lungiselela imibhalo, izithombe namalogo, futhi wabelane ngempendulo uma unayo.
process.2.result: Inguqulo yokuqala ongayizama. Iwebhusayithi elula ivamise ukuphothulwa ezinsukwini zomsebenzi ezi-1–3 uma izinto sezilungile.
process.3.long: Sivivinya umphumela ndawonye. Noma yini engalungile kahle iyalungiswa, bese konke kuvivinywa futhi kuze kusebenze kahle ezinsizeni ezahlukene futhi kulungele ukwethulwa.
process.3.you: Zama umphumela bese usitshela ukuthi yini ongathanda ukuyilungisa.
process.4.long: Umkhiqizo uyashicilelwa futhi uvulelwe wonke umuntu. Siwusetha ukuze ube lula ukuwuthola ku-Google, bese sikudlulisela ukufinyelela kanye nesiqondiso sokusetshenziswa ukuze uwuphathe ngokukhululeka.
process.4.do.3: Ukukweseka ngonyaka o-1 wokulungiswa mahhala, kanye nedomeyini (iphakheji Encane) noma i-hosting (iphakheji Enkulu)
process.4.you: Gcina ukufinyelela kwakho kuphephile futhi uqale ukukwabelana namakhasimende akho.
process.4.result: Iwebhusayithi noma i-app isebenza ngempela futhi isilungele ukusetshenziswa.
projects.description: Iphrojekthi ngayinye iklanyelwe ukudlulisa imiyalezo yebhizinisi ngokucacile, ihlale iguquguquka kunoma iyiphi insiza, futhi yenze kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthatha isinyathelo.

packages.0.description: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo, i-CV yomuntu siqu noma ikhasi lokufika elilula elithuleka ngokushesha.

faq.title: Imibuzo evame ukuvela ngaphambi kokuqala.
faq.description: Uma umbuzo wakho ungaphendulwanga lapha, isikhathi sokubonisana singasiza ukunquma izidingo zakho.
faq.0.question: Yiziphi izinsiza ezingenziwa yi-Nocoding?
faq.0.answer: Senza amawebhusayithi ephothifoliyo noma e-CV yomuntu siqu, amakhasi okufika noma amaphrofayili ezinkampani, izinhlelo zolwazi nezokusebenza, kanye nokuzenzakalela kwezinqubo zebhizinisi.
faq.1.question: Inqubo yokwakha ithatha isikhathi esingakanani?
faq.1.answer: Iphothifoliyo yomuntu siqu, i-CV noma ikhasi lokufika elilula livame ukuthatha izinsuku zomsebenzi ezi-1-3 ngemuva kokuba izinto sezilungile. Amaphrojekthi amakhulu axhomeke ezicini ezidingekayo, ekuxhumaniseni nasesimweni sempendulo.
faq.2.question: Ingabe idizayini nezici zingenziwa ngokwezifiso?
faq.2.answer: Yebo. Idizayini, isakhiwo samakhasi, izici nokugeleza komsebenzi kungalungiswa ngokwezidingo zakho. Idizayini izobuyekezwa ndawonye ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukwakhiwa.
faq.3.question: Yini ehlanganiswe emanani?
faq.3.answer: Amanani ahlanganisa ukwakhiwa ngokwephakheji nesilinganiso esivunyelwene ngaso. Iphakheji Encane ihlanganisa ukulungiswa mahhala nedomeyini unyaka o-1, kuyilapho iphakheji Enkulu ihlanganisa ukulungiswa mahhala ne-hosting unyaka o-1.
contact.title: Sitshele ngezidingo zakho zewebhusayithi. Sizosiza ukuyihlela kahle indlela.
contact.description: Thumela isifinyezo esifushane sebhizinisi lakho, amakhasi owafunayo nesikhathi osifunayo. Impendulo yokuqala izoba nezincomo zesilinganiso nezinyathelo ezilandelayo. Ukubonisana kuhlale kungamahhala, noma nini lapho ukudinga.
footer.tagline: Amawebhusayithi ebhizinisi alungele ukwethulwa, abukeka eqinile futhi alula ukuwakhulisa.
project.description.ecoswap: Imakethe ye-inthanethi yokuthenga nokuthengisa izinto ezisetshenzisiwe. Abantu bangafaka, bavivinye futhi bathenge kalula besefonini noma ekhompyutheni.
project.description.wiboost: Isitolo se-inthanethi samasevisi edijithali afana nokugcwalisa imidlalo, amaphakheji edatha nama-app aphambili, nebhalansi yamakhasimende nohlelo lwabathengisi bokuthengisa kabusha.
project.description.ahawi: Iwebhusayithi yephothifoliyo yomuntu siqu ngesitayela sokupenda ngamanzi enezilimi ezimbili, ukwethula iphrofayili, ulwazi nemininingwane yokuxhumana.
project.description.abdi: Uhlelo lwamarekhodi lweziphathimandla zasesigodlweni (abdi dalem) zeKeraton yaseSurakarta: ukubhalisa, idatha yomuntu siqu, amashejuli emisebenzi, ukuba khona nokuphrinta amakhadi okuhlonza.
project.description.sfarm: I-app yokuphatha ipulazi lemiphakathi lezinkukhu ezibeka amaqanda nezimbuzi: amarekhodi aqhubeka nsuku zonke, ukuthengisa, izindleko nemibiko yezimali.
project.description.payu: Inkundla exhumanisa abantu abafaka imisebenzi nabasebenzi abazimele. Abafaka imisebenzi banikeza umvuzo, abasebenzi abazimele baqedela umsebenzi, futhi inkokhelo yenziwa nge-QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Ikhathalogi ye-inthanethi enemikhiqizo engaphezu kwenkulungwane. Abathengi bangasesha, bahlunge futhi bayalele ngqo nge-WhatsApp.
project.description.ianprem: Isitolo se-inthanethi ama-akhawunti ama-app aphambili afana ne-Netflix ne-Spotify. Abathengi bayakhetha futhi bakhokhe bebodwa, kuyilapho abalawuli bephatha isitoko nokuthengisa.
project.description.alengka: Ikhathalogi ye-inthanethi yefenisha yangaphakathi nangaphandle yama-kafe, ezindaweni zokudlela nasemakhaya. Izivakashi zingabuka iqoqo futhi zibonisane nge-WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni yesikole samabanga aphansi enephrofayili yesikole, ulwazi lokwamukelwa kwabafundi abasha, uhlu lootishela, imisebenzi engeyona eyekilasi nezimpumelelo zabafundi.
project.description.furnix: Ikhathalogi ye-inthanethi yefenisha yensimbi evela eJepara yama-kafe, ezindaweni zokudlela nasemakhaya. Izivakashi zikhetha imikhiqizo futhi ziyayalela ngokuthanda kwazo.
project.description.clothique: Isitolo sezingubo se-inthanethi esiphelele: ikhathalogi, ikalishi lokuthenga, inkokhelo ye-inthanethi, ibhulogi nendawo yomlawuli yokuphatha ama-oda nemibiko.
project.description.agli: Ithuluzi lamathimba okuqukethwe lokuqoqa izibonelo zokuqukethwe okubukwe kakhulu, ukubona amaphethini nokubhala imibhalo yemibhalo emisha.
project.description.nebulist: Umsizi wokuthengisa osebenzisa i-AI owenza isu, amanothi abathengi abangaba khona nemibhalo yemiyalezo yokubaxhumanisa ngokususelwa olwazini lomkhiqizo.
project.description.carbonfi: I-app yezezimali zedijithali yokuhwebelana ngamakhredithi ekhabhoni (imivuzo yokunciphisa ukukhishwa) nezinhlelo zemivuzo ethanda imvelo.
project.description.protectedpay: I-app ephephile yokudlulisa imali yedijithali: izimali ziyakhululwa kuphela uma sezitholakele, kunezinkokhelo zeqembu nokonga.
project.description.pedulichain: Inkundla yokunikela esobala: wonke umnikelo nendlela izimali ezisetshenziswa ngayo kurekhodwa unomphela futhi kubonakala kunoma ubani.
project.description.astra: Umsizi we-AI ongaxoxa naye nje ukuphatha izimpahla zedijithali, njengokuthumela amathokheni noma ukudala izinto zedijithali eziqoqwayo, ngaphandle kolwazi lokubhala ikhodi.
project.description.auditfi: Isihloli sokuphepha esisekelwe ku-AI sezinhlelo zezimali zedijithali esithola izindawo ezibuthaka futhi sibhale umbiko ngemizuzwana.
project.description.p2p: Inkundla yokushintshisana ngezimpahla zedijithali ngqo phakathi kwabasebenzisi, enokuvikelwa kwezindleko nendawo yomlawuli yokuqhuba inkundla.
project.description.payguppy: I-app esiza izitolo ezijwayelekile ukwamukela izinkokhelo ngemali yedijithali kusetshenziswa amakhodi e-QR esevele enawo.
project.description.tiptap: Inkundla yabadali bokuqukethwe yokuthola amathiphu avela kubabukeli ngemali yedijithali noma ngezinto zedijithali eziqoqwayo, enezaziso ngesikhathi sokusakaza bukhoma.
project.description.senkus: Umdlalo we-inthanethi onomkhakha wesayensi nama-alchemy: abadlali bahlanganisa izidakamizwa, baqoqe izinto zedijithali futhi bancintisane enkundleni.
project.description.quickstock: I-app yekhompyutha yokuphatha isitoko sesitolo sezingubo: irekhoda ukuthengisa, ukulethwa kwabahlinzeki nemibiko yesitoko, ngokufinyelela okususelwe endimeni yesisebenzi ngasinye.
project.description.caer: Inkundla yokubolekisa nokuboleka izimpahla zedijithali phakathi kwamanethiwekhi, esekela irupiya yedijithali ye-IDRX, kwenza kube lula ukonga nokuboleka.
